raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Two more slow NVIDIA steps move to automatic sharding, following #60492, #60662, #60757 and #60858:

| Step | Before | Planned shards (est. min) |
|---|---|---|
| `model-executor` (H200 MIG 35GB) | ~48 min | 3 × 15.7 |
| `pipeline-context-parallelism-4-gpus` (4×L4) | ~44 min | 3: 17.7 / 16.4 / 6.3 |

Language Models (Hybrid) was in the first version of this PR and is now left on its fixed shards. Each of its jobs builds mamba and causal-conv1d from source (~15 min), so a third shard cost +26% GPU time.

## Test Plan

[Buildkite build 94188](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94188) ran only these steps. Every shard passed, and the shard plugin was active for every pytest command. The baseline is main nightly 94125.

| Step | Shards (job min) | Wall, main → PR | Job-min, main → PR | Tests, PR vs main |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| model-executor | 3: 17.4, 17.6, 16.9 | 47.9 → **17.6** | 47.9 → 51.9 (+8%) | 972 passed / 22 skipped, same |
| PP+CP (×4 L4) | 3: 19.3, 17.9, 7.1 | 43.7 → **19.3** | 43.7 → 44.3 (+1%) | 36 passed, same |

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

files.patch:
@@ -638,6 +638,7 @@ steps:
 
 - label: ":nvidia: (L4) Pipeline + Context Parallelism"
   key: pipeline-context-parallelism-4-gpus
+  automatic_shard: true
   timeout_in_minutes: 55
   working_dir: "/vllm-workspace/tests"

 - label: ":nvidia: (H200 MIG 35GB) Model Executor"
   device: h200_35gb
   key: model-executor
+  automatic_shard: true
   timeout_in_minutes: 60
   source_file_dependencies:
   - vllm/engine/arg_utils.py
